title: FERRETS: A Scalable Symbolic Transform for Time Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.33249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dictionary methods for time series build bags of symbolic words from subsequences, but the accurate ones scale poorly. Against other families of methods, their accuracy no longer pays for their cost. We present FERRETS, a label-free dictionary transform built on WEASEL~2. It keys windows of random length and dilation into exact eight-bit words, adds a level word of each window's mean and spread, and on multivariate data adds cross-channel words. We compare it with leading classifiers, deep networks and foundation models included, on the UCR, Multiverse and MONSTER archives. FERRETS is the fastest of the eleven methods timed on UCR under a ten-thread budget. Of the ten others, only MultiRocket-Hydra is significantly more accurate, taking 24.7 times as long. FERRETS is not significantly different from WEASEL~2, the most accurate earlier dictionary method, which takes 125 times as long, and is significantly ahead of the other dictionary met

translated_title: FERRETS：一种可扩展的时间序列分类符号化变换方法
translated_abstract: 时间序列的字典方法通过从子序列构建符号词的词袋进行分类，但准确性高的方法扩展性差，与其他方法族相比，其准确性已无法弥补其高昂的代价。我们提出了FERRETS，一种构建在WEASEL 2之上的无标签字典变换。它将随机长度和扩张率的窗口映射为精确的八位词，为每个窗口的均值和离散程度添加水平词，并在多变量数据上添加跨通道词。我们在UCR、Multiverse和MONSTER数据存档上将其与领先的分类器（包括深度网络和基础模型）进行比较。在十线程预算下，FERRETS是UCR上测试的十一种方法中最快的。在其他十种方法中，只有MultiRocket-Hydra的准确性显著更高，但耗时是FERRETS的24.7倍。FERRETS与此前最准确的字典方法WEASEL 2无显著差异，而后者耗时是FERRETS的125倍，且FERRETS显著优于其他字典方法。
tldr: FERRETS是一种基于WEASEL 2的无标签字典变换方法，通过将随机长度和扩张率的窗口映射为精确八位符号词，在达到与最准确字典方法相当的分类精度的同时，速度提升超过百倍，成为测试中速度最快的时间序列分类方法。
en_tdlr: FERRETS is a label-free dictionary transform built on WEASEL 2 that keys random-length, dilated windows into exact eight-bit symbolic words, achieving accuracy on par with the most accurate dictionary method while being over 100 times faster, making it the fastest among the time series classifiers tested.
